codeReview.summary: Commit 6588e49 adds broad panel test coverage and removes the remaining legacy dashboard CSS, and the current dashboard implementation covers most of the fh-dashboard-panels scope. The feature still misses one explicit requirement, though: the UploadsPanel forms do not actually reset after submission because the handlers only call form.reset() while the select/text inputs are controlled from React state. The new UploadsPanel tests also miss that required behavior, so the regression slipped through despite the handoff claiming comprehensive coverage.

issues.description: Both upload handlers try to reset the forms with `event.currentTarget.reset()` (source at lines 403-407, artifact at lines 432-436), but UploadsPanel receives controlled values from `uploads` state (`sourceProjectId`, `sourceRef`, `artifactProjectId`, `artifactSourceRef`, `artifactRuntime`) at lines 574-579 and mutates that same state at lines 586-591. Because the controlled values are never cleared, only the file input resets; the previously selected project/ref/runtime fields remain populated after upload, so the required UploadsPanel form-reset behavior is not actually implemented.

The new UploadsPanel suite only checks rendering, messages, disabled state, loading text, and file input presence. It never exercises submit/reset behavior through the page-level handlers, so the feature's required form-reset behavior went untested even though the handoff describes the panel coverage as comprehensive.
